notes.note: Reviewed Play and TestFlight setup against their tagged workflow paths. Stable APK and AAB must match the configured Play upload certificate fingerprint; the reusable iOS job still takes Stable signing and upload values from native-release. The documented first AAB bootstrap and provider readback are still required.

Reviewed the tagged release source and identity, Android artifact checks, and TestFlight caller against the citing documents. Stable now runs the existing fingerprint-bound verifiers before staging and uses the same secret forwarding as the established TestFlight callers. Checked that desktop, container, channel, promotion and publication steps are untouched. This covers source and focused tests; provider staging remains pending on a new qualified candidate.

The checkout-local Java fixture covers strict signature behavior separately; the YAML check establishes the caller contract.
